title.title: The Correspondence of the Yarnall family

msIdentifier.institution: Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College

projectDesc.p: The correspondence of the Yarnall family is stored at the Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College. With the generous support of H. David and Joyce E. Hunt, Library staff scanned and transcribed these letters in 2024 and encoded the text in TEI.

div.p: thy dear father is in town, I saw him last evening. He is pretty well, says thy brother in Chester County is well. I often think of thee, my Dear Child. I hope thou has thy health and may be a good example to little James, & I hope he is kind to thee, & that you all live in love together. I cannot tell when I may return to you but I hope as soon as is right tell little James he should right to me thee first opportunity

closer.salute: In haste conclude with love, thy adopted caretaker
